questions.expected_answer_from_fixed_key: Choose only world deck or own-region discard, 2 Supply for discard, world cost 2 at zero Visions, 3 at one/two, 4 at three–five, modified by powers (Darkest Secret makes world draw 2). observed_answer.answer: Search chooses either your region discard pile (cost 2 Supply) or the world deck, never both. A Vision in a discard pile neither stops drawing nor advances the track. No reshuffle is implied if the source empties.

questions.question: How do you Recover a relic versus either banner, and what happens to the old banner resources?
questions.expected_answer_from_fixed_key: 1 Supply; facedown relic at pawn site only at printed site cost, then take faceup personal bank. Either banner from anywhere, even yourself: pay more favor/secrets than old amount, stack new payment. People’s Favor flips off Mob and old favor distributes singly along banks away from deck from any starting suit wrapping. Darkest Secret: take one old secret, previous holder gets rest (self gets all; bank remainder stays bank).

observed_answer.answer: Recover costs 1 Supply. For a facedown relic at your site, pay its printed site cost (favor to indicated bank, or burn the stated favor/secrets) and hold it faceup in your personal bank. Either banner may be recovered from anywhere, including yourself or shared bank, by strictly outbidding its current amount. With People’s Favor, place payment on banner, distribute its old favors singly to suit banks in printed order starting at a chosen bank, and flip it normal if Mob. With Darkest Secret, put new secrets on it; new holder takes one old secret and previous holder gets the rest (self-recovery returns all old secrets to self; shared-bank remainder stays there).

questions.question: How are Campaign attack/defense calculated, and how do skulls, hollow swords, ties and sacrifices work?
questions.expected_answer_from_fixed_key: The attacker may collect attack dice up to the number of warbands in their attacking force (normally those on their board), after accounting for any applicable power that changes that force. Defense shields multiplied by each double (x2,x4,...), plus warbands at targeted sites and defender board if pawn at attacker or targeted site; bandits one per targeted site. Attack skulls kill own force immediately; paired hollow swords count one, lone hollow zero. Attack must strictly exceed defense; may sacrifice force warbands +1 each, exactly enough to win, no excess; if unable/decline defender wins.

observed_answer.answer: Attack dice are chosen up to the attacking force’s warband count; choosing fewer dice does not reduce the force. Defense dice derive from targets plus mandatory title/modifier bonuses. Defense total is rolled shields (doubles multiply shields only) plus defending warbands at targeted sites and defender board force only if their pawn is at attacker site or a target; bandits add one per targeted bandit site. Each attack skull kills one attacker force warband. Count full swords plus one per pair of hollow swords; leftover hollow sword scores zero. Attacker may sacrifice surviving force warbands for +1 each but only exactly enough to win. Attack must strictly exceed defense; tie means defender wins.

observed_answer.answer: When an Imperial player defends, Chancellor automatically joins; other non-attacking Citizens may join with permission if their pawn is at attacker site or a target. Allied board warbands defend only when their pawn is at attacker site or a target. Chancellor chooses Imperial casualties. Citizen attacking Chancellor/another Citizen is non-Imperial for that Campaign; Chancellor attacking Citizen likewise makes that Citizen non-Imperial. questions.expected_answer_from_fixed_key: Four favor per suit bank (three with two–four players). People’s Favor normal with one favor, Darkest Secret one secret. Chancellor two favor,one secret,three purple board warbands; other players one favor,one secret,three board warbands (own color Exile,purple Citizen). All full Supply.

observed_answer.answer: With five players, later game has 4 favor per suit bank. Banners each start with 1 resource (People’s Favor normal with 1 favor; Darkest Secret with 1 secret). Chancellor additionally Oathkeeper and gets Darkest Secret for Devotion or People’s Favor for People; no starting Reliquary relic for Citizen.

questions.question: Describe later-game discard seeding, starting adviser selection and Vision counting. Are starting Reliquary relic placements chosen or random?

Four relics randomly placed facedown one per Reliquary space.

questions.question: Can you act at a remote ruled site to Muster/Trade, use a normal Action power there, or use a battle plan at your pawn site that you do not rule? How do persistent powers differ?
questions.expected_answer_from_fixed_key: Muster/Trade only pawn site. Normal card power accessible by ruling card or pawn at its site, so remote ruled Action accessible. Battle plan requires rule, pawn alone insufficient. Persistent black-thick-braid power affects specified players ignoring ordinary access.

observed_answer.answer: Remote ruling does not permit Muster/Trade; those use empty eligible card at pawn site. Ordinary Action powers can be accessed if you rule the card or pawn is at its site. Battle plan at pawn site requires ruling it, not merely pawn presence. Persistent powers (thick black braid) affect specified players regardless of ordinary access.
